seam_geometry.note: Near-mode splices at geometrically matched endpoints. If the junction jump were far out in the tail of ordinary steps, a one-line abs(diff) detector would win and the kinetic claim would be unfalsifiable in the wrong direction (Wu & Keogh, IEEE TKDE 2023).

note: statistics computed per PROTEIN; replicates averaged first to avoid pseudo-replication

C5_null_control_at_chance.note: MUST pass for any other criterion to be interpretable. An elevated null means block-position bias (e.g. slow drift), not anomaly detection.

C2_beats_best_baseline_on_80pct.note: OI-27: comparison family widened on 2026-08-30 to include the trivial temporal detectors. Strictly stricter than the blind-only version.

C3_blind_medians_in_band.note: time-blind only, by design - trivial temporal detectors are NOT expected at chance

C7_beats_trivial_temporal_on_prauc.note: Added 2026-08-30 (OI-27). Surprise must beat the best trivial temporal detector on PR-AUC, not only ROC-AUC. An additional gate, not a relaxation.

C6_random_score_at_chance.note: Added 2026-08-29 after the standards audit. An additional gate, not a relaxation: random scores must be at chance or nothing else is interpretable.
